lines.zh: 我一个方步一个方步地走。
lines.en: I march forward, square step by square step.

lines.zh: 我是黏土捏的，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I'm made of clay and my joints creak.
My colour is pale blue.
Each step lifts to the same height.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙边走成一条直线。
lines.en: I walk the wall in a straight line.
I make one circuit of the yard.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上留下小印。
lines.en: My feet leave small prints.
I walk at you without turning.
My sword swings at my side.
I walk into the rank and take my place.
I step through a puddle.
I go around the stone in the way.
I stand still as a lump of clay.
I tip my head slightly.
The blue on me is a little dulled.
I'm waiting for my owner's orders.

lines.zh: 风把我的边角吹干了一点。
lines.en: The wind dries my edges a little.
My pale blue was dyed on.
My fingers are still stiff.
I raise a hand and look at my palm.
I keep watch without moving.
I'm deciding whether you're an enemy.
You don't match my colour.
I bring my sword up across my chest.
I'm waiting for my owner to speak.
There's dust on you.
I don't decide on my own.
Our rank stands right here.
I'm watching both your hands.
Don't touch us.
You aren't wearing any armor.
There are far more of us than you.
A crack opens along my arm.
That cracks my shoulder.
I shake the clay dust off.
There's a dent in me.
I look down at the crack.
I slowly straighten up again.
I make no sound at all.
Dust has mixed into my colour.
Even like this I can stand.
I never eat any of this.
Are you going to dye me?
I'll stand here and let you.
I'm not particular about colour.
I can't take that.
My hand stays on the sword.
Don't bring out anything else.
This whole body of mine is pale blue.
I'm waiting for the next order.

lines.zh: 这一下在我身上留了道印。
lines.en: It leaves a mark on me.
One foot sinks half a step.
A little clay falls off me.
My boots sink into the dirt.
I back off and reform my stance.
You're lighter, and I don't give way.
I straighten the sword again.

lines.zh: 我是烧硬的黏土，撞上会疼。
lines.en: I am fired clay; running into me hurts.
The two of us stand together.
Her colour is a little deeper.
We lay our swords side by side.
She taps my shoulder.
Her clay is drier than mine.
At night we stand together.
We hold this ground.
Neither of us moves.
My hands are too stiff to hold it.
It slips out of my hand.
I hold it up to show my owner.
I shouldn't take what isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰上的泥缝。
lines.en: I wedge it into a seam at my waist.
I go back to holding my sword.

lines.zh: 这根木棍，我能插成武器。
lines.en: This stick I can set as a weapon.
Wool found here; just right for padding.
I judge you an enemy.
I raise my sword.
My rank turns toward you.

lines.zh: 淡蓝色的我朝你压过来了。
lines.en: Light blue and all, I bear down on you.
I don't shout; none of us do.

lines.zh: 我的泥手锁死了你的位置。
lines.en: My clay hand has locked onto your position.
I sink my body a notch lower.
We spread into a half circle.
I've marked you.
I lift my sword at you.
I'm moving forward now.
I'm right here — coming.
This one aims to finish it.
I watch the hand on your sword.
The ones behind me are following.
You've blocked the middle of the yard.
My blade stays level.
I raise my shield and close in.
We have you surrounded.
My feet are on your shadow.
Your hand is behind your waist.
I can see what you're thinking.
I shift my blade to the left.
My comrade goes round the other side.

lines.zh: 我数着你脚下的每一步。
lines.en: I keep count of every step under your feet.
I bring the sword down.

lines.zh: 剑砍在你的护甲上，弹开。
lines.en: The blade rings off your armor.

lines.zh: 我连出两下，都朝同一个地方。
lines.en: Two strikes, both at the same spot.

lines.zh: 我们三个人一起压上去。
lines.en: Three of us press in together.

lines.zh: 这一下砍在你的手腕上。
lines.en: That lands on your wrist.
I'm shoved back three paces.
I look at the notch in my blade.
I charge in again.
A crack opens in my arm.

lines.zh: 我砍中了，你的袖子破了。
lines.en: I connect; your sleeve tears.
You retreat; we follow.
My club cracks against its shoulder.
I can't catch breath, and I don't stop.
You're down; we close around you.
I lower my sword slowly.
A lump of clay drops to the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，腿先成形。
lines.en: I rise slowly, legs forming first.
I'm pale blue and clean.
I look at the sword in my hand.
There's still damp on me.
I take my place in the rank.
I wait for the first order.
The ones beside me are clay too.
My fingers open slowly.
I grip the sword tighter.

lines.zh: 火烤得我发硬，边角卷了。
lines.en: Fire hardens me and my edges curl.
I break half a leg in the fall.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀掉了一只胳膊。
lines.en: The blast takes an arm off me.

lines.zh: 一根箭头扎进我的胸口。
lines.en: An arrowhead lodges in my chest.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的形状散了。
lines.en: The light loosens my shape.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会干。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I can still dry out.

lines.zh: 雷打在泥上，我裂成两半。
lines.en: Lightning hits the clay and I split in two.

lines.zh: 淡蓝色的我，一摔就掉色。
lines.en: Light blue, and a fall chips my paint.
